summary: Via Renewables, Inc. filed an 8-K solely to disclose entry into a $300 million senior secured revolving credit facility with Bank OZK and other lenders. The facility expires May 6, 2029, and covers working capital, acquisitions, swingline loans, and letters of credit. Interest rates are based on Base Rate or Term SOFR plus margins ranging from 1.75%-3.25% depending on leverage. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other special-situation event is described. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
